notes: Doubts: (1) 002C2280: the second argument is `lea rdx, [rip+0x60]` resolving to 002C2320, 0x3C bytes past the body and not marked `fn`, so the sentence does not name it; FABLE may name it if it is a function. (2) 00574080: when `rcx` is null the body still dereferences `rcx+0xE0`, so the null branch at 005740B0 is not a real guard and is not stated; `rdx` reaches the `00576030` call unchanged but is not set up there, so only the stack buffer is named; the return value is not stated because `00808C40` runs after `rax` is set.
